sources.title: Hardware Requirements & Quantization Guide | ai-models-lab/minimax-h3 ...
sources.snippet: This page provides a technical breakdown of the hardware specifications and optimization strategies required to run the MiniMax H3 (Hailuo AI 3.0) model locally. It covers the relationship between GPU architecture, VRAM capacity, and quantization formats, alongside specific ComfyUI configuration flags for different hardware tiers.
